photos.c: Ben Challenger (left) had to settle for silver in the high jump thanks to another super performance from Haringey's Dalton Grant (right).

Front Page. Ben Challenger soared over 2 metres 30 in Gothenburg to win the European Under 23 Championship and in the process equal his own Club Record set a week or so earlier at the World University Games.
Gothenburg and the European Under 23 Championships. Ben Challenger is in patriotic mood after soaring over 2.30m in the high jum to capture his second major gold medal of the season.
Top right: Ben Challenger cleared 2.20m to share the lead.
